description: Use when testing cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration on an authorized engagement. Covers probing Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflection, credentialed CORS with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, null origin trust, wildcard and subdomain allowlist bypasses, preflight (OPTIONS) abuse, and building an HTML proof of concept that reads cross-origin API responses with a victim's cookies. Use when APIs return ACAO headers, when the frontend calls cross-origin APIs, or when Burp Suite 2026.2 flags permissive CORS policies on session-handling endpoints.
